title: Get started (learners)
description: Find and use hubs on Kahana: open Explore, search and filter, save or follow, and give Aura—without creating a hub yet.
content:
This guide gets you from “what is this?” to browsing Explore, opening a hub, saving or following, and optionally giving Aura—in a few minutes of reading.

Primary action: Open Explore

What you’ll do

Discover curated hubs → open what looks useful → save or follow → give Aura when something deserves it.

Step 1 — Open Explore

  1. Go to app.kahana.io/explore.
  2. Browse most non-adult public hubs without an account.
  3. Use the tabs: Hubs vs Creators (?tab=hubs or ?tab=creators).

Step 2 — Search and filter

  1. Search by keywords for what you want to learn.
  2. Filter by category, free vs paid, tags, and sort (popular when browsing; relevance when searching).
  3. Tip: start with a niche you care about so the catalog feels small and useful.

Step 3 — Open a hub

  1. Open a card to land on the hub page (or a creator’s profile from the Creators tab).
  2. Free hubs: open the content (adult hubs follow the note below).
  3. Paid hubs: you’ll see a paywall if you don’t have access yet. Purchase unlocks through Stripe — see Buying & access.

Step 4 — Make it sticky (account)

After you sign up or sign in:

  • Save hubs you want to reopen.
  • Follow creators you trust.
  • Bookmark app.kahana.io so Kahana is one click away.

Step 5 — Give Aura (optional but core)

  • You must be logged in.
  • You get up to 5 Aura per day (resets at midnight UTC).
  • Give Aura to hubs only—not people or profiles.
  • You can’t give Aura to your own hubs.
  • Aura is scarce on purpose. Use it carefully. It is not money and not a paywall currency.

Rules and blockers: How Aura works. Philosophy: Features: Aura or the full Aura guide.

Adult content note

  • Adult hubs can be listed but often stay hidden by default on Explore.
  • Access needs login and age verification (date of birth, 18+). There is no anonymous “I’m 18” unlock.

How-to: Adult content & age verification. Overview: Features: Trust.

Quick facts

  • Guest browse: yes for most non-adult public Explore listings.
  • Save / follow: needs an account.
  • Aura: 5/day, hubs only, no self-Aura, not money.
  • Paid hubs: unlock via Stripe purchase.
